gloss: to turn color, to change color

definitions.gloss: to turn color, to change color
definitions.explanation: For leaves, fruit, or other things to change color, especially referring to autumn foliage or ripening fruit.

examples.japanese: {秋|あき}になると、{銀杏|いちょう}{並木|なみき}が{黄色|きいろ}く{色|いろ}づく。
examples.english: In autumn, the ginkgo trees turn yellow.

examples.japanese: {紅葉|もみじ}が{色|いろ}づき{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: The autumn leaves have started to change color.

examples.japanese: トマトが{赤|あか}く{色|いろ}づいた。

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive). Pattern: Xが{色|いろ}づく.

ASPECT: ている indicates a state of having changed color.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{葉|は}が{色|いろ}づく (leaves change color)
・{紅葉|こうよう}が{色|いろ}づく (autumn foliage turns color)
・{赤|あか}く{色|いろ}づく (to turn red)
・{黄色|きいろ}く{色|いろ}づく (to turn yellow)

SEASON: This verb is particularly associated with autumn ({秋|あき}) when describing foliage.
